per_prediction.description: Standard benchmark datasets (e.g., MoleculeNet, ChEMBL, PDBbind, PubChem BioAssay, ZINC15) are never used in the reported claims.
The literature contains no empirical studies on molecular property prediction (e.g., solubility, toxicity, bioactivity) using graph neural networks.
There is a complete absence of work on protein–ligand interaction modeling and binding affinity prediction with GNNs.
Methodological comparisons across core GNN variants (MPNN, GCN, GAT, Graph Transformers) are missing.
No studies have investigated de novo molecular generation and optimization using graph‑based generative models.
Contrastive self‑supervised learning on molecular graphs has not been explored in the corpus.
Evaluations are limited to generic claims; there is no real‑world, prospective, or human‑in‑the‑loop assessment of GNN‑driven drug discovery pipelines.
